name: camellia sinensis seed oil
uses: Wipe the affected area clean, take out this product and apply it evenly on the affected area. Remember not to apply it on healthy skin. If there is a layer of hard skin on the surface of the affected area, you can trim it slightly and apply it to facilitate penetration.
otcwarn: Discontinue use if signs of irritation or rash occur. Discontinue use if signs of irritation or rash occur.
